packageRules.description: The workflow's renovate-version input resolves to ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate, and GHCR publishes no release timestamp, so the shared 4-day soak would hold it forever. docker.io/renovate/renovate publishes the same index digests (44.107.0: sha256:fb6b7c66be211ee72de037eb48d269da7cf90f30c773e893b6b8002bffafcd4b on both) with tag_last_pushed dates, so look tags up there. The action still pulls from GHCR.
